text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Body of industrialist Vehbi Koc stolen from his grave in Istanbul. Police detain four members of cemetery staff.
- Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan's Welfare Party trying to persuade seven MPs from the opposition Motherland Party to defect.
- MP from coalition's secularist wing resigns in dismay at Islamists.
- Turkey to built second international airport in Istanbul by 1997.
- Court sentences Islamist killer of leading secularist lawyer to life imprisonment.
- European Parliament freezes European Union aid to Turkey because of its poor human rights record.
- Survey shows that the armed forces are the most respected institution int the country.
- Iraqi Kurdish leader Jalal Talabani says he will not permit Turkish Kurd guerrillas to operate on his territory.
